# Introduction

The IRM crop suitability model requires spatial data for the various biophysical criteria or requirements.

The global or continental data are often too large to store in the IRM spatial data directory.

Therefore we will create a mask of Nigeria that we will use to clip the other data.

We will also merge soil raster data that have separate files for different soil horizons. These will be weighted and used in the IRM, but need to be saved previously as separate bands in a raster GeoTiff file.



# Mask and Resolution

The mask will be the boundary of Nigeria using the states dataset that we use throughout the Atlas.

The spatial resolution will be 5km, but at this stage we will only use the boundary to clip the data using its native resolution. The clip will include all pixels touching the boundary.


# Load the Nigeria boundary


```{r}
#| label: boundary
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| cache: false
#| results: asis

vect_state_geo <- vect("D:/DatosProyecto/SpatialData/Africa/Pais/Nigeria/NGA Admin 2019-2025 OSGOF-Ehealth-UNCS/nga_admin1_topo.topojson") 

vect_ng_geo <- vect_state_geo |> aggregate(by = "adm0_pcode")

crs(vect_ng_geo) <- "epsg:4326"

vect_ng_geo$adm0_pcode <- as.factor(vect_ng_geo$adm0_pcode)

ext(vect_ng_geo)

ggplot(vect_ng_geo)+
  geom_spatvector(aes(fill = adm0_pcode)) +
  geom_spatvector_text(aes(label = adm0_pcode), size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Nigeria",
    fill = "State<br>Code") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(),
    legend.title = element_markdown(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )


```


## Climate

### Precipitation

CHIRPS cumulative rainfall amounts - dekadal, monthly averages (https://data.chc.ucsb.edu/products/CHIRPS-2.0/)

Using the 30 year average for 1991-2020.


```{r}
#| label: clip_chirps_ppt
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| cache: false
#| results: asis

rast_chirps_d <- rast("E:/SpatialDataExternal/CHIRPSv3/raw_data/chirps_9120_avg.tif")

rast_chirps_d

rast_chirps_d_ng <- crop(rast_chirps_d, vect_ng_geo)

rast_chirps_d_ng

rm(rast_chirps_d)

gc()

ggplot()+
  geom_spatraster(data = rast_chirps_d_ng$r9120_dekad011_avg) +
  geom_spatvector(data = vect_ng_geo, fill = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Nigeria CHIRPS Precipitation 1991-2020 - Dekad 1",
    fill = "(mm)") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(),
    legend.title = element_markdown(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )


writeRaster(rast_chirps_d_ng, "E:/repos/IRM_shiny/data/spatial_data/chirps_9120_nigeria.tif", overwrite=TRUE)

```


### Temperature

CHELSA

Using the 30 year average for 1981-2010.

#### Monthly mean daily average temperature

```{r}
#| label: clip_chelsa_tas
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| cache: false
#| results: asis

rast_chelsa_tas_m <- rast("E:/SpatialDataExternal/CHELSA/climatologies/tas/CHELSA_tas_year_1981-2010_V.2.1.tif")

rast_chelsa_tas_m

rast_chelsa_tas_m_ng <- crop(rast_chelsa_tas_m, vect_ng_geo)

rast_chelsa_tas_m_ng

rm(rast_chelsa_tas_m)

gc()

ggplot()+
  geom_spatraster(data = rast_chelsa_tas_m_ng$`CHELSA_tas_01_1981-2010_V.2.1`) +
  geom_spatvector(data = vect_ng_geo, fill = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Nigeria CHELSA mean monthly temperature 1981-2010 - January",
    fill = "(degC)") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_markdown(),
    legend.title = element_markdown(),
    axis.title = element_blank()
  )


writeRaster(rast_chelsa_m_ng, "E:/repos/IRM_shiny/data/spatial_data/chelsa_tas_8110_nigeria.tif", overwrite=TRUE)

```
